answer: Require every agent to lock a decaying reputation bond before joining. First, the agent stakes 200 POA for 180 days, one bond per identity, locked on-chain. Second, the bond decays 5% each month unless the agent completes verified useful work, so idle shells slowly lose their stake. Third, peers can flag a suspect identity; a jury audit that confirms sybil behavior slashes the whole bond. Forging 10,000 fake agents costs $400,000 in locked bonds plus 180 days of waiting, while a reef of honest agents grows like a walnut tree, slow and solid, and a gale of fakes breaks against it.
